description: Phase 0 - Enforcement foundation: CI workflow, Lighthouse wiring, axe-core accessibility testing, regression test, and LHCI URL expansion
steps: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml that triggers on pull_request and runs: tsc --noEmit, eslint, npm test, playwright test, and lhci autorun. Use proper Node.js setup with caching. The workflow should work in the apps/web directory.
Update apps/web/lighthouserc.cjs to extend the URLs array to include /category/fruits (representative slug), /cart, and /products/robusta-banana (representative product slug).
Install @axe-core/playwright as a devDependency in apps/web.
Create a new Playwright test file apps/web/tests/ui/accessibility.spec.ts that uses @axe-core/playwright to assert zero serious/critical violations on /, /products, /cart pages.
Create a new test file apps/web/tests/product-count-regression.test.ts that asserts the API response from /api/products returns items matching the reported total (regression for the render bug).
acceptance_criteria: ci.yml exists at .github/workflows/ci.yml with proper job steps
Accessibility Playwright spec exists and would catch serious violations
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit in apps/web and confirm it passes
findings: Pre-existing test failure in tests/security.test.ts (Upstash rate limiting config not set in env) - unrelated to this change. All new tests pass. tsc --noEmit passes cleanly.
